summary: Multi-role (owner/employee/kitchen) tested end-to-end. All 6 pytest cases pass (auth/onboarding/restaurant/team/PIN rotation/staff login+RBAC). All 14 Playwright scenarios pass: unauth login shows both buttons; fresh-owner onboarding form renders and submits; onboarded owner sees full nav + Owner Toolkit + Realtime Controls; Team page copy/toggle/add/remove/rotate all work; employee staff login lands on /orders with restricted sidebar and hard-gate redirects /payouts and /team to /orders; kitchen staff login lands on /kitchen with only nav-kitchen, /orders redirects to /kitchen; role label 'Kitchen crew' correct; logout returns to /login.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py stores employee_pin_plain/kitchen_pin_plain in the DB alongside hashes so the owner Team page can show them. This is convenient but weakens defence-in-depth: a DB leak reveals every staff PIN. Consider hashing only and re-issuing PINs on rotation (owner sees plain only on the rotation response).
App.js is 499 lines and packs Shell, all pages, auth, controls, and hub in one file. Split into src/pages/*, src/components/Shell.jsx, src/auth/* for maintainability.

StaffLoginPage.doLogin calls window.location.reload() after navigate — the navigate becomes a no-op due to the reload. Works because the reload rehydrates via /api/auth/me, but cleaner to just reload OR just navigate+refetch.
TeamPage `rest[`${role}_pin`]` relies on backend keys employee_pin/kitchen_pin — consistent, but no loading/error UI when PATCH/POST fail (silent fail on network errors).
test_credentials: Seeded via mongosh (see test_multirole.py::seed_owner and inline e2e seed). Owner sessions use role='owner'; staff sessions issued through /api/staff/login. Fresh e2e seed cookie flags: httpOnly, secure, sameSite=None, domain=partner-panel-2.preview.emergentagent.com.
seed_data_creation: test_multirole.py seeds+cleans per-test owners prefixed 'test-owner-'. Frontend run used e2e-owner-onboarded / e2e-owner-fresh which were cleaned up after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints: /api/onboarding, /api/restaurant (GET/PATCH), /api/team (POST) + /api/team/{id} (DELETE), /api/staff/lookup, /api/staff/login all working. Session cookie set with httpOnly+secure+samesite=none. RBAC enforced on owner-only endpoints (403 for staff cookies). Frontend Shell + RoleGate + HOME_ROUTE all wired correctly. If regression needed, re-run pytest and the Playwright script; no known flaky tests.
